e.b: 50 indicators, eight pillars, one 0–100 score, and a grade from S to D. Every step traces back to a number you can check.

e.b: 50 indicators are computed for every patent. Most are calculated from the patent record: citations, family, claims, dates, legal status. The rest are graded by closed-database AI tools reading the patent text.
e.zb: 每件專利都會計算 50 項指標。多數由專利紀錄計算 — 引用、家族、請求項、日期、法律狀態。其餘由封閉資料庫的 AI 工具閱讀專利文本後評分。

e.b: Indicators aggregate into eight pillars. Each pillar rolls up its own indicators as a weighted average, and the pillars are then weighted independently of each other.
e.zb: 指標會聚合為八大支柱。每根支柱以加權平均彙整旗下指標的分數，支柱之間再各自獨立加權。

e.b: A score is a position, so it needs a set to hold a position in. Your patent is ranked against 1433 patents held by TIS and its partners, patents we also license commercially.
e.zb: 分數是一個位置，所以它需要一個可以站定位置的集合。你的專利是拿來跟 1433 件由泰然與夥伴所持有的專利比較排名 — 這些專利我們同時也在做商業授權。

e.t: A raw value becomes a position
e.b: Every indicator is normalised the same way: rank the raw value inside the pool, take its percentile. A patent with 47 forward citations is not scored on 47. It is scored on where 47 falls among 1433.
e.zb: 每一項指標都以同一種方式正規化：把原始值拿到池內排名，取它的百分位。一件被前向引用 47 次的專利，分數不是 47，而是 47 在 1433 件之中的落點。

e.b: The weighted pillar scores compose into one PSS on a 0–100 scale, and that score's percentile in the pool resolves to one of five grades.
e.zb: 加權後的支柱分數合成為一個 0–100 分的 PSS 總分，這個總分在池內的百分位再對應到五個評級之一。

e.zb: 您是我們客戶的期間，我們絕不以它們對付您。

e.b: Demand for unmanned systems in Taiwan is arriving faster than the capacity to sustain them, and 9 of 16 leading foreign UAV makers hold no Taiwan patents.
e.zt: 為何是台灣，為何是現在
e.zb: 台灣對無人載具的需求，到來的速度快過維運量能；而主要外國無人機製造商，16 家中有 9 家在台灣沒有任何專利。

e.t: Demand is arriving faster than sustainment capacity.
e.zt: 需求到來的速度，快過維運量能。

e.b: The Armaments Bureau is buying 11,270 aircraft in 2026 and 37,480 in 2027, multi-award, with no PRC-origin components and domestic components preferred.
e.zb: 軍備局 2026 年採購 11,270 架、2027 年 37,480 架，採多家決標，不得使用中國製零組件，並優先採用國產零組件。

e.b: NT$44.2 bn coordinated by the Ministry of Economic Affairs to build the domestic UV industry.
e.zt: 無人載具產業發展計畫
e.zb: 經濟部統籌 442 億新台幣，發展國內無人載具產業。

e.b: Passed in May 2026 with an NT$780 bn ceiling. Its UAV and counter-UAS systems are bought through foreign military sales, so foreign makers will field systems in Taiwan that need local sustainment.
e.zb: 2026 年 5 月通過，上限 7,800 億新台幣。其中的無人機與反無人機系統經由對外軍售採購，因此外國製造商將在台灣部署需要在地維運的系統。

e.b: 9 of 16 leading foreign UAV makers hold no Taiwan patents. Once systems are fielded they get studied, and without Taiwan filings a maker has no position against local imitation and no leverage with local suppliers.
e.zb: 主要外國無人機製造商，16 家中有 9 家在台灣沒有任何專利。系統一旦部署就會被研究；沒有台灣專利，製造商就無法對抗在地仿製，也沒有與在地供應商談判的籌碼。

e.t: What a foreign maker needs, and who offers it today

e.zb: 沒有人整合提供；每家製造商各自臨時建立。
